newsitem.title: UK: UK funds turn wary on equities - Merrill poll.
newsitem.headline: UK funds turn wary on equities - Merrill poll.

text.p: UK fund managers are wary about increasing their exposure to all world equity markets except Japan following the recent bull run in equity prices, a survey by Merrill Lynch said.
It said in its May survey sellers outnumbered buyers by 12 and 10 percent respectively in UK and U.S. equities among UK fund managers.
The number of buyers of continental Europe and Pacific Rim equity markets fell sharply in May, it said.
"Fund managers are looking only towards Japanese equities," it said, with buyers outnumbering sellers by 27 percent.
It said managers did see value in bonds in which they were keen investors both domestically and internationally.
The survey was carried out by Gallup on behalf of Merrill between May 1 and 7, covering 67 institutions responsible for funds totalling $1,936 billion.
